newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR mostly higher on year-end factors.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR mostly higher on year-end factors.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were higher in most maturities, as banks sought to beef up year-end positions, traders said on Tuesday.
"Banks want to be liquid as much as possible," a dealer said, referring to the Christmas and New Year holidays.
Banks are also doing some window-dressing for the year-end, leadint them to swap dollars for pesos at the PHIBOR market, traders said.
Among the term rates, the one-month and one-year rates did not move. The one-month rates had been adjusted on Monday, while the one year was less vulnerable to changes, dealers said.
